First cross-machine Reverie dataset, analyzed 2026-07-22. SOURCES: personal ~/.reverie (2,395 telemetry rows, 2026-04-29→07-22, 45 active days) + work-machine copy at /Users/kh/Projects/Liminal/reverie-work (495 rows, 2026-05-29→07-22, 18 active days, github.gwd.broadcom.net SED projects — treat values as employer-confidential; the audit log carries them in plaintext, [[context.auditRecordProperties]] #3 demonstrated for real).

FINDINGS (feed the v1.3.0 Trust theme-pick and the soak eval):
1. TEST LEAK QUANTIFIED (#130): 56% of the personal log (1,337/2,395 rows) is test/temp traffic — 934 reverie_init (638 on 2026-05-08 alone) + temp-dir projects (codex-init-*, codex-cli-restruct-*) + test keys (b, commands.build, dep.key, resolved.old) which dominate all-time write-amp stats. Work log is clean (13 inits, max amp 3×/day).
2. PHANTOM SESSIONS AT SCALE (#119 leftover): 96% of CLI sessions are single-call on BOTH machines (1,671/1,738 personal; 280/289 work). BUT the work machine proves RVR_SESSION works when used: 3 named bulk-init sessions with write manifests in sessions/*.json (80/37/27 keys). Session derivation is the top observability gap.
3. ATTRIBUTION ROLLOUT GAP (#45): work machine 100% unattributed; personal only 13 rows (8 fable, 5 sol) since fleet policy. Per-harness env config doesn't propagate across machines — supports ambient agent detection over env fingerprints.
4. ORGANIC USAGE IS HEALTHY: work hit rate 88% (121/16), avg written value 395B (seed-sized), handoff convention propagated (15 context.next_session writes), write:read ~1:1 once the 216 bulk-init burst writes (61% of work writes, <100ms apart) are excluded. Bulk-init is a distinct usage mode — segment it in stats, don't let it read as write-amp.
5. PROJECT IDENTITY FRAGMENTS: same repo counts as multiple projects across path variants (seabear.dev/reverie vs seabearDEV/Reverie vs seabearDEV/reverie). projectBreakdown and the soak gate's distinct-projects criterion overcount — canonicalize (git remote?) before trusting.
6. miss-paths.jsonl IS AN UNUSED GOLDMINE: records unmet knowledge demand (query, explorationBytes, resolution moved_on/timeout) — nothing surfaces it. "Agents searched X, found nothing, N times" is the seed-suggestion feature hiding in existing data.
7. CROSS-MACHINE MERGE (v1.15+ stats --import) now has a real dataset to design against; schema note: work rows lack agent, sessions/*.json manifests exist only where RVR_SESSION was set.
